        return '';

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_585206e483d6b6108372fecfeeaad331
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1850691_zeyad_0.ShippingAPIRequest</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ShippingAPIRequest</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ShippingAPIRequest = Class.create();
ShippingAPIRequest.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    airShippingAPI: function(flightnumber) {
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("AIR Current Shipping", "GET Flight Full Postion"); //Query Paramaters 
        request.setStringParameter("flights", flightnumber);
        //API Calling 
        var response = request.execute();
        var status = response.getStatusCode();
        if (status == 200) {
            //case success responce 
            return JSON.parse(response.getBody());
        } else {
            // case failed responce. even if the api token is expired
            gs.error("API Call Failed. Status: " + status);
            return null;
        }
    },
    seaShippingSearchAPI: function(vessel_name) {
        var request = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2("SEA Current Shipping", "GET Vessel Search");
        //Query Paramaters
        request.setStringParameter("name", vessel_name);
        //API Calling
        var response = request.execute();
        var status = response.getStatusCode();
        if (status == 200) {
            //case success responce 
            return JSON.parse(response.getBody());
        } else { // case failed responce. even if the api token is expired
            gs.error("API Call Failed. Status: " + status);
            return null;
        }
    },
    seaShippingStatusAPI: function(mmsi, imo) {
		//searching by MMSI
        if (mmsi) {
        var reqMmsi = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(
            "SEA Current Shipping",
            "GET Vessel Status - mmsi"
        );
        reqMmsi.setStringParameter("mmsi", mmsi);

        var resMmsi = reqMmsi.execute();
        if (resMmsi.getStatusCode() === 200) {
            var bodyMmsi = JSON.parse(resMmsi.getBody());

            if (bodyMmsi && bodyMmsi.data) {
                return bodyMmsi;
            }
        }
    }

        // searching by IMO if MMSI did not return any result
        if (imo) {
        var reqImo = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(
            "SEA Current Shipping",
            "GET Vessel Status - imo"
        );
        reqImo.setStringParameter("imo", imo);

        var resImo = reqImo.execute();
        if (resImo.getStatusCode() === 200) {
            var bodyImo = JSON.parse(resImo.getBody());

            if (bodyImo && bodyImo.data) {
                return bodyImo;
            }
        }
    }

        // If both searches failed
        gs.info("No vessel found for MMSI: " + mmsi + " or IMO: " + imo);
        return null;
    },
    landShippingAPI: function() {},
    type: 'ShippingAPIRequest'

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $timeout, $window, spModal) {
    var c = this;

    // Load SweetAlert2 CSS and JS dynamically
    (function() {
        // Load CSS
        if (!document.getElementById('swal2-css')) {
            var link = document.createElement('link');
            link.id = 'swal2-css';
            link.rel = 'stylesheet';
            link.href = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/limonte-sweetalert2/11.7.32/sweetalert2.min.css';
            document.head.appendChild(link);
        }

        // Load JS
        if (!window.Swal && !document.getElementById('swal2-js')) {
            var script = document.createElement('script');
            script.id = 'swal2-js';
            script.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/limonte-sweetalert2/11.7.32/sweetalert2.all.min.js';
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        }
    })();

    // Initialize data
    c.data.currentSlide = 1;

    c.forceTypeahead = function($event) {
        $timeout(function() {
            var el = $event && $event.target;
            if (!el) return;

            // triggers uib-typeahead even when input is empty
            el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {
                bubbles: true
            }));
            el.dispatchEvent(new Event('keyup', {
                bubbles: true
            }));
        }, 0);
    };

    c.data.formData = {
        shipping_type: null,
        shipping_from: '',
        shipping_from_sys_id: '',
        shipping_to: '',
        shipping_to_sys_id: '',
        fragility: null,
        // Air shipping fields
        cargo_weight: null,
        cargo_width_m: null,
        cargo_length_m: null,
        cargo_height_m: null,
        cargo_content: '',
        cargo_description: '',
        additional_air_transport_notes: '',
        // Sea shipping fields
        container_size: '',
        quantity_of_containers: null,
        container_content: '',
        // Land shipping fields
        land_shipping_discription: '',
        land_shipping_option: '',
        land_size: '',
        land_weight: null
    };
    c.data.errorMessage = '';
    c.data.successMessage = '';
    c.data.loadingFromCountries = false;
    c.data.loadingToCountries = false;
    c.data.noFromResults = false;
    c.data.noToResults = false;

    // Get countries from core_country table
    c.getCountries = function(searchTerm) {
        return c.server.get({
            action: 'getCountries',
            searchTerm: searchTerm || ''
        }).then(function(response) {
            return response.data.countries || [];
        });
    };

    // Handle country selection
    c.onFromCountrySelect = function(item) {
        if (item) {
            c.data.formData.shipping_from = item.name;
            c.data.formData.shipping_from_sys_id = item.sys_id;
        }
    };

    c.onToCountrySelect = function(item) {
        if (item) {
            c.data.formData.shipping_to = item.name;
            c.data.formData.shipping_to_sys_id = item.sys_id;
        }
    };

    // Select shipping type
    c.selectShippingType = function(type) {
        c.data.formData.shipping_type = type;
        c.data.errorMessage = '';
    };

    // Select fragility option
    c.selectFragility = function(isFragile) {
        c.data.formData.fragility = isFragile;
        c.data.errorMessage = '';
    };

    // Navigation functions with smooth animation
    c.nextSlide = function() {
        if (c.canProceed()) {
            c.data.errorMessage = '';
            c.data.currentSlide++;

            // Scroll to top of widget smoothly
            $timeout(function() {
                var element = document.querySelector('.shipping-request-widget');
                if (element) {
                    element.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            }, 100);
        } else {
            c.data.errorMessage = 'Please complete all required fields before proceeding.';
        }
    };

    c.previousSlide = function() {
        c.data.errorMessage = '';
        c.data.successMessage = '';
        c.data.currentSlide--;

        // Scroll to top of widget smoothly
        $timeout(function() {
            var element = document.querySelector('.shipping-request-widget');
            if (element) {
                element.scrollIntoView({
                    behavior: 'smooth',
                    block: 'start'
                });
            }
        }, 100);
    };

    // Validation for each slide
    c.canProceed = function() {
        switch (c.data.currentSlide) {
            case 1:
                return c.data.formData.shipping_type !== null;
            case 2:
                return c.data.formData.shipping_from_sys_id !== '' &&
                    c.data.formData.shipping_to_sys_id !== '';
            case 3:
                return c.data.formData.fragility !== null;
            default:
                return true;
        }
    };

    // Validate final slide based on shipping type
    c.validateFinalSlide = function() {
        var formData = c.data.formData;

        if (formData.shipping_type === 'air') {
            return formData.cargo_weight &&
                formData.cargo_width_m &&
                formData.cargo_length_m &&
                formData.cargo_height_m &&
                formData.cargo_content &&
                formData.cargo_description;
        } else if (formData.shipping_type === 'sea') {
            return formData.container_size &&
                formData.quantity_of_containers &&
                formData.container_content;
        } else if (formData.shipping_type === 'land') {
            var baseValid = formData.land_shipping_discription &&
                formData.land_shipping_option;

            if (formData.land_shipping_option === 'custom_shipping_weight') {
                return baseValid && formData.land_size && formData.land_weight;
            }

            return baseValid;
        }

        return false;
    };
    
    // Submit form with SweetAlert2
    c.submitForm = function() {
        if (!c.validateFinalSlide()) {
            c.data.errorMessage = 'Please complete all required fields.';
            return;
        }

        c.data.errorMessage = '';

        // Call server script to submit the form
        c.server.get({
            action: 'submitShippingRequest',
            formData: c.data.formData
        }).then(function(response) {
            if (response.data.success) {
                var createdSysId = response.data.sysId;
                
                // Wait for SweetAlert2 to be loaded
                var checkSwal = setInterval(function() {
                    if (window.Swal) {
                        clearInterval(checkSwal);
                        
                        // Show SweetAlert2 loading indicator
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: 'Creating Request...',
                            html: 'Please wait while we process your shipping request.',
                            allowOutsideClick: false,
                            allowEscapeKey: false,
                            allowEnterKey: false,
                            showConfirmButton: false,
                            didOpen: function() {
                                Swal.showLoading();
                            }
                        });

                        // Wait 5 seconds then redirect
                        $timeout(function() {
                            // Close the SweetAlert
                            Swal.close();
                            
                            // Redirect to request details page with the actual sys_id
                            var redirectUrl = 'https://dev215416.service-now.com/shipping_app?id=request_details&sys_id=' + createdSysId;
                            $window.location.href = redirectUrl;
                        }, 5000);
                    }
                }, 100);

            } else {
                c.data.errorMessage = 'Error submitting request: ' + (response.data.message || 'Unknown error occurred');
            }
        }).catch(function(error) {
            c.data.errorMessage = 'Error submitting request. Please try again.';
            console.error('Submission error:', error);
        });
    };

    // Reset form
    c.resetForm = function() {
        c.data.currentSlide = 1;
        c.data.formData = {
            shipping_type: null,
            shipping_from: '',
            shipping_from_sys_id: '',
            shipping_to: '',
            shipping_to_sys_id: '',
            fragility: null,
            cargo_weight: null,
            cargo_width_m: null,
            cargo_length_m: null,
            cargo_height_m: null,

            container_content: '',
            land_shipping_discription: '',
            land_shipping_option: '',
            land_size: '',
            land_weight: null
        };
        c.data.errorMessage = '';
        c.data.successMessage = '';
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.shipping-request-widget {

} /* Progress Indicator */
.progress-indicator {

  position: relative;
}
.progress-indicator::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;

  height: 2px;
  background: #e0e0e0;
  z-index: 0;
}
.step {
  flex: 1;

  z-index: 1;
}
.step-number {
  width: 40px;

  color: #666;

  align-items: center;

}

}
.step.completed .step-number {
  background: #28a745;

.step-label {

}
.step.active .step-label {

} /* Slides Container with Right to Left Animation */
.slides-wrapper {

}
.slides-container {

}
@keyframes slideInTitle {

.shipping-option h3,

}

} /* Form Container */
.form-container {
  max-width: 600px;

  animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out;
}
.form-group {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.form-group label {
  display: block;

}

}

} /* Navigation Buttons */
.navigation-buttons {

}

}
.btn-default {
  background: #f5f5f5;

}
.btn-default:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #e0e0e0;

}
.btn-primary {

.btn-success:hover:not(:disabled) {

}
.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
} /* Alert Messages */
.alert {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  animation: slideDown 0.4s ease-out;
}

.dropdown-menu { z-index: 99999 !important; }

@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;

  }
}
.alert-danger {

}
.alert-success {
  background: #d4edda;

} /* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .shipping-type-container,
  .temperature-container {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .shipping-option,
  .temperature-option {
    min-width: 100%;
  }
  .form-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .progress-indicator {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .step-number {
    width: 30px;

  }
  .step-label {
    font-size: 10px;
  }

    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .shipping-request-widget {
    padding: 15px;
  }
} /* Additional animations for better UX */
.form-group {
  animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease-out backwards;
}
.form-group:nth-child(1) {
  animation-delay: 0.1s;
}
.form-group:nth-child(2) {

}
.form-group:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}
.form-group:nth-child(4) {
  animation-delay: 0.4s;
}
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

  // Initialize data
  data.currentSlide = 1;
  
  // Handle getting countries for typeahead
  if (input && input.action === 'getCountries') {
    var searchTerm = input.searchTerm || '';
    var countries = [];
    
    try {
      var gr_country = new GlideRecord('core_country');
      gr_country.addActiveQuery();
      
      // Search by country name
      if (searchTerm) {
        gr_country.addQuery('name', 'CONTAINS', searchTerm);
      }
      
      gr_country.orderBy('name');
      gr_country.setLimit(20); // Limit results
      gr_country.query();
      
      while (gr_country.next()) {
        countries.push({
          sys_id: gr_country.getValue('sys_id'),
          name: gr_country.getValue('name'),
          iso_code: gr_country.getValue('iso_code')
        });
      }
      
      data.countries = countries;
      
    } catch(e) {
      gs.error('Error fetching countries: ' + e.message);
      data.countries = [];
    }
  }
  
  // Handle form submission
  if (input && input.action === 'submitShippingRequest') {
    var formData = input.formData;
    
    // Debug logging
    gs.info('=== SHIPPING REQUEST SUBMISSION DEBUG ===');
    gs.info('Form Data Received: ' + JSON.stringify(formData));
    
    try {
      // Validate required common fields
      if (!formData.shipping_type) {
        data.success = false;
        data.message = 'Shipping type is required';
        gs.error('Validation Error: Shipping type is required');
        return;
      }
      
      if (!formData.shipping_from_sys_id) {
        data.success = false;
        data.message = 'From country is required';
        gs.error('Validation Error: From country is required');
        return;
      }
      
      if (!formData.shipping_to_sys_id) {
        data.success = false;
        data.message = 'To country is required';
        gs.error('Validation Error: To country is required');
        return;
      }
      
      if (formData.fragility === null || formData.fragility === undefined) {
        data.success = false;
        data.message = 'Fragility selection is required';
        gs.error('Validation Error: Fragility is required');
        return;
      }
      
      // Create a new record in the shipping request table
      var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1850691_zeyad_0_shipping_request');
      gr.initialize();
      
      gs.info('GlideRecord initialized successfully');
      
      // Set common fields
      gr.setValue('shipping_type', formData.shipping_type);
      gr.setValue('shipping_from', formData.shipping_from_sys_id);
      gr.setValue('shipping_to', formData.shipping_to_sys_id);
      gr.setValue('fragility', formData.fragility);
      
      // Set state and assignment_group
      gr.setValue('state', '2');
      gr.setValue('assignment_group', '14e5f7ae83067a508372fecfeeaad364');
      
      gs.info('Common fields set - Type: ' + formData.shipping_type +

      // Air shipping fields
      if (formData.shipping_type === 'air') {
        gs.info('Setting AIR shipping fields');
        
        if (formData.cargo_weight) gr.setValue('cargo_weight', formData.cargo_weight);
        if (formData.cargo_width_m) gr.setValue('cargo_width_m', formData.cargo_width_m);
        if (formData.cargo_length_m) gr.setValue('cargo_length_m', formData.cargo_length_m);
        if (formData.cargo_height_m) gr.setValue('cargo_height_m', formData.cargo_height_m);
        if (formData.cargo_content) gr.setValue('cargo_content', formData.cargo_content);
        if (formData.cargo_description) gr.setValue('cargo_description', formData.cargo_description);
        
        // NEW FIELD: Additional air transport notes (optional)
        if (formData.additional_air_transport_notes) {

      // Sea shipping fields
      if (formData.shipping_type === 'sea') {

          gs.error('Validation Error: Missing sea shipping fields - Container Size: ' +

        }
        
        gr.setValue('container_size', formData.container_size);
        gr.setValue('quantity_of_containers', formData.quantity_of_containers);
        gr.setValue('container_content', formData.container_content);
        
        gs.info('Sea fields set - Size: ' + formData.container_size +

      if (formData.shipping_type === 'land') {

        gs.info('Land fields set successfully');
      }
      
      // Set requested by to current user

        gs.info('Set opened_by to: ' + currentUser);
      }
      
      // Insert the record

      var sysId = gr.insert();

        gs.info('Record inserted successfully! Sys ID: ' + sysId);
        
        // Verify the record actually exists by querying it back
        var verifyGr = new GlideRecord('x_1850691_zeyad_0_shipping_request');
        if (verifyGr.get(sysId)) {
          gs.info('VERIFICATION SUCCESS: Record exists in database');
          gs.info('Record details - Number: ' + verifyGr.getValue('number') + 
                  ', Shipping Type: ' + verifyGr.getValue('shipping_type') +
                  ', State: ' + verifyGr.getValue('state') +
                  ', Assignment Group: ' + verifyGr.getValue('assignment_group') +
                  ', Sys ID: ' + sysId);
          
          data.success = true;
          data.requestNumber = verifyGr.getValue('number') || sysId;
          data.sysId = sysId;
          data.message = 'Record created and verified. Sys ID: ' + sysId;
          
        } else {
          gs.error('VERIFICATION FAILED: Record was inserted but cannot be retrieved!');
          gs.error('This could indicate ACL issues or the record was deleted by a business rule');
          
          data.success = false;
          data.message = 'Record was created but cannot be verified. Check ACLs and Business Rules.';
        }
        
      } else {
        gs.error('FAILED: gr.insert() returned null or empty');
        gs.error('Check for: 1) Required fields missing, 2) Business rules blocking insert, 3) Data policies');
        
        data.success = false;
        data.message = 'Failed to create shipping request. The record could not be inserted.';
      }
      
    } catch(e) {
      gs.error('EXCEPTION in shipping request submission: ' + e.message);
      gs.error('Stack trace: ' + e.stack);
      
      data.success = false;
      data.message = 'Error: ' + e.message;
    }
    
    gs.info('=== END SHIPPING REQUEST SUBMISSION ===');
  }

<div id="shipping-request-widget" class="shipping-request-widget">
  <!-- Progress Indicator -->
  <div class="progress-indicator">
    <div
      class="step"
      ng-class="{'active': c.data.currentSlide === 1, 'completed': c.data.currentSlide > 1}"
    >
      <div class="step-number">1</div>
      <div class="step-label">Shipping Type</div>
    </div>
    <div
      class="step"
      ng-class="{'active': c.data.currentSlide === 2, 'completed': c.data.currentSlide > 2}"
    >
      <div class="step-number">2</div>
      <div class="step-label">Location</div>
    </div>
    <div
      class="step"
      ng-class="{'active': c.data.currentSlide === 3, 'completed': c.data.currentSlide > 3}"
    >
      <div class="step-number">3</div>
      <div class="step-label">Temperature</div>
    </div>
    <div class="step" ng-class="{'active': c.data.currentSlide === 4}">
      <div class="step-number">4</div>
      <div class="step-label">Details</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Slides Container with Animation -->
  <div class="slides-wrapper">
    <div
      class="slides-container"
      ng-style="{'transform': 'translateX(-' + ((c.data.currentSlide - 1) * 100) + '%)'}"
    >
      <!-- Slide 1: Shipping Type Selection -->
      <div class="slide">
        <h2>Select Shipping Type</h2>
        <div class="shipping-type-container">
          <div
            class="shipping-option"
            ng-class="{'selected': c.data.formData.shipping_type === 'air'}"
            ng-click="c.selectShippingType('air')"
          >
            <div class="icon-container air-icon">
              <i class="fa fa-plane fa-5x"></i>
            </div>
            <h3>Air Shipping</h3>
            <p>Fast and efficient</p>
          </div>
          <div
            class="shipping-option"
            ng-class="{'selected': c.data.formData.shipping_type === 'sea'}"
            ng-click="c.selectShippingType('sea')"
          >
            <div class="icon-container sea-icon">
              <i class="fa fa-ship fa-5x"></i>
            </div>
            <h3>Sea Shipping</h3>
            <p>Cost-effective for bulk</p>
          </div>
          <div
            class="shipping-option"
            ng-class="{'selected': c.data.formData.shipping_type === 'land'}"
            ng-click="c.selectShippingType('land')"
          >
            <div class="icon-container land-icon">
              <i class="fa fa-truck fa-5x"></i>
            </div>
            <h3>Land Shipping</h3>
            <p>Reliable ground transport</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Slide 2: Location Selection -->
      <div class="slide">
        <h2>Select Shipping Location</h2>
        <div class="form-container">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="shipping_from"
              >From Country <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <input type="text"
       id="shipping_from"
       class="form-control"
       ng-model="c.data.formData.shipping_from"
       uib-typeahead="country as country.name for country in c.getCountries($viewValue)"
       typeahead-loading="c.data.loadingFromCountries"
       typeahead-no-results="c.data.noFromResults"
       typeahead-min-length="0"
       typeahead-on-select="c.onFromCountrySelect($item)"
       typeahead-append-to-body="true"
       ng-focus="c.forceTypeahead($event)"
       autocomplete="off"
       placeholder="Search for origin country..."
       required>
            <i
              ng-show="c.data.loadingFromCountries"
              class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin"
            ></i>
            <div
              ng-show="c.data.noFromResults && c.data.formData.shipping_from"
            >
              <i class="fa fa-times"></i> No Results Found
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="shipping_to"
              >To Country <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
           <input type="text"
       id="shipping_to"
       class="form-control"
       ng-model="c.data.formData.shipping_to"
       uib-typeahead="country as country.name for country in c.getCountries($viewValue)"
       typeahead-loading="c.data.loadingToCountries"
       typeahead-no-results="c.data.noToResults"
       typeahead-min-length="0"
       typeahead-on-select="c.onToCountrySelect($item)"
       typeahead-append-to-body="true"
       ng-focus="c.forceTypeahead($event)"
       autocomplete="off"
       placeholder="Search for destination country..."
       required>
            <i
              ng-show="c.data.loadingToCountries"
              class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin"
            ></i>
            <div ng-show="c.data.noToResults && c.data.formData.shipping_to">
              <i class="fa fa-times"></i> No Results Found
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Slide 3: Temperature Selection -->
      <div class="slide">
        <h2>Fragility Requirement</h2>
        <div class="temperature-container">
          <div
            class="temperature-option"
            ng-class="{'selected': c.data.formData.fragility === true}"
            ng-click="c.selectFragility(true)"
          >
            <div class="icon-container refrigerated-icon">
              <i class="fa fa-snowflake-o fa-5x"></i>
            </div>
            <h3>Refrigerated</h3>
            <p>Temperature-controlled shipping</p>
          </div>
          <div
            class="temperature-option"
            ng-class="{'selected': c.data.formData.fragility === false}"
            ng-click="c.selectFragility(false)"
          >
            <div class="icon-container non-refrigerated-icon">
              <i class="fa fa-cube fa-5x"></i>
            </div>
            <h3>Non-Refrigerated</h3>
            <p>Standard shipping conditions</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Slide 4: Shipping Details -->
      <div class="slide">
        <h2>Shipping Details</h2>
        <!-- Air Shipping Fields -->
        <div
          ng-if="c.data.formData.shipping_type === 'air'"
          class="form-container"
        >
          <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group col-md-6">
              <label for="cargo_weight"
                >Cargo Weight <span class="required">*</span></label
              >
              <input
                type="number"
                id="cargo_weight"
                class="form-control"
                ng-model="c.data.formData.cargo_weight"
                placeholder="Enter weight"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group col-md-6">
              <label for="cargo_width_m"
                >Cargo Width (m) <span class="required">*</span></label
              >
              <input
                type="number"
                id="cargo_width_m"
                class="form-control"
                ng-model="c.data.formData.cargo_width_m"
                placeholder="Enter width in meters"
                step="0.01"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group col-md-6">
              <label for="cargo_length_m"
                >Cargo Length (m) <span class="required">*</span></label
              >
              <input
                type="number"
                id="cargo_length_m"
                class="form-control"
                ng-model="c.data.formData.cargo_length_m"
                placeholder="Enter length in meters"
                step="0.01"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group col-md-6">
              <label for="cargo_height_m"
                >Cargo Height (m) <span class="required">*</span></label
              >
              <input
                type="number"
                id="cargo_height_m"
                class="form-control"
                ng-model="c.data.formData.cargo_height_m"
                placeholder="Enter height in meters"
                step="0.01"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="cargo_content"
              >Cargo Content <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <input
              type="text"
              id="cargo_content"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.cargo_content"
              placeholder="Enter cargo content"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="cargo_description"
              >Cargo Description <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <textarea
              id="cargo_description"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.cargo_description"
              placeholder="Enter detailed cargo description"
              rows="3"
              required
            ></textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="additional_air_transport_notes"
              >Additional Air Transport Notes</label
            >
            <textarea
              id="additional_air_transport_notes"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.additional_air_transport_notes"
              placeholder="Enter any additional notes (optional)"
              rows="3"
            ></textarea>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Sea Shipping Fields -->
        <div
          ng-if="c.data.formData.shipping_type === 'sea'"
          class="form-container"
        >
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="container_size"
              >Container Size <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <select
              id="container_size"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.container_size"
              required
            >
              <option value="">-- Select Container Size --</option>
              <option value="20ft">20ft Container</option>
              <option value="40ft">40ft Container</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="quantity_of_containers"
              >Quantity of Containers <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <input
              type="number"
              id="quantity_of_containers"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.quantity_of_containers"
              placeholder="Enter number of containers"
              min="1"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="container_content"
              >Container Content <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <textarea
              id="container_content"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.container_content"
              placeholder="Enter container content details"
              rows="3"
              required
            ></textarea>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Land Shipping Fields -->
        <div
          ng-if="c.data.formData.shipping_type === 'land'"
          class="form-container"
        >
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="land_shipping_discription"
              >Land Shipping Description <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <textarea
              id="land_shipping_discription"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.land_shipping_discription"
              placeholder="Enter shipping description"
              rows="3"
              required
            ></textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="land_shipping_option"
              >Land Shipping Option <span class="required">*</span></label
            >
            <select
              id="land_shipping_option"
              class="form-control"
              ng-model="c.data.formData.land_shipping_option"
              required
            >
              <option value="">-- Select Shipping Option --</option>
              <option value="custom_shipping_weight">
                Custom Shipping Weight
              </option>
              <option value="container_shipping">Container Shipping</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <!-- Conditional fields for custom_shipping_weight -->
          <div
            ng-if="c.data.formData.land_shipping_option === 'custom_shipping_weight'"
          >
            <div class="form-group">
              <label for="land_size"
                >Land Size <span class="required">*</span></label
              >
              <input
                type="text"
                id="land_size"
                class="form-control"
                ng-model="c.data.formData.land_size"
                placeholder="Enter size dimensions"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
              <label for="land_weight"
                >Land Weight (kg) <span class="required">*</span></label
              >
              <input
                type="number"
                id="land_weight"
                class="form-control"
                ng-model="c.data.formData.land_weight"
                placeholder="Enter weight in kg"
                step="0.01"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Navigation Buttons -->
  <div class="navigation-buttons">
    <button
      class="btn btn-default"
      ng-click="c.previousSlide()"
      ng-disabled="c.data.currentSlide === 1"
    >
      <i class="fa fa-arrow-left"></i> Back
    </button>
    <button
      class="btn btn-primary"
      ng-click="c.nextSlide()"
      ng-if="c.data.currentSlide < 4"
      ng-disabled="!c.canProceed()"
    >
      Next <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i>
    </button>
    <button
      class="btn btn-success"
      ng-click="c.submitForm()"
      ng-if="c.data.currentSlide === 4"
      ng-disabled="!c.validateFinalSlide()"
    >
      <i class="fa fa-check"></i> Submit Request
    </button>
  </div>
  <!-- Error Messages -->
  <div
    ng-if="c.data.errorMessage"
    class="alert alert-danger"
    style="margin-top: 15px"
  >
    <i class="fa fa-exclamation-circle"></i> {{c.data.errorMessage}}
  </div>
  <!-- Success Message -->
  <div
    ng-if="c.data.successMessage"
    class="alert alert-success"
    style="margin-top: 15px"
  >
    <i class="fa fa-check-circle"></i> {{c.data.successMessage}}
  </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; color: #0b2a3a; } .ship-pager { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ship-pager .btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ship-pager .btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #0b2a3a; color: white; border-color: #0b2a3a; } .ship-pager .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ship-page { font-weight: 600; color: #0b2a3a; font-size: 14px; min-width: 90px; text-align: center; } .ship-info { margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: #666; font-weight: 500; } /* Container for smooth transitions */ .ship-container { margin-top: 14px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .ship-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), opacity 0.3s ease; } /* Slide animation classes */ .ship-grid.slide-out-left { animation: slideOutLeft 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards; } .ship-grid.slide-out-right { animation: slideOutRight 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards; } .ship-grid.slide-in-left { animation: slideInLeft 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards; } .ship-grid.slide-in-right { animation: slideInRight 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards; } /* Keyframe animations */ @keyframes slideOutLeft { from { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } to { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; } } @keyframes slideOutRight { from { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } to { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; } } @keyframes slideInLeft { from { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } } @keyframes slideInRight { from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } } /* Card Styles */ .ship-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; text-decoration: none !important; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ship-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 4px; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0b2a3a 0%, #1b4e8a 100%); transform: scaleY(0); transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ship-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.12); border-color: #0b2a3a; } .ship-card:hover::before { transform: scaleY(1); } /* Card Header */ .ship-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #f5f5f5; } .ship-number { font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; color: #0b2a3a; letter-spacing: -0.5px; } .ship-state { font-size: 11px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eef6ff; color: #1b4e8a; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; white-space: nowrap; } /* State color variations */ .ship-state.state-1 { background: #fff4e6; color: #d97706; } .ship-state.state-2 { background: #e0f2fe; color: #0369a1; } .ship-state.state-3 { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ship-state.state-3-rejected { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; } .ship-state.state-4 { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; } /* Description */ .ship-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #374151; line-height: 1.5; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; min-height: 42px; } /* Route Information */ .ship-route { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .route-item { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; } .route-item i { color: #0b2a3a; font-size: 14px; } .route-label { font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; } .route-value { font-weight: 700; color: #0b2a3a; } .route-arrow { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; } /* Metadata Grid */ .ship-meta-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; } .meta-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; background: #fafafa; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ship-card:hover .meta-item { background: #f5f5f5; } .meta-item i { color: #0b2a3a; font-size: 16px; margin-top: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; } .meta-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; } .meta-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .meta-value { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #0b2a3a; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } /* Responsive adjustments */ @media (max-width: 768px) { .ship-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .how-reel-play:hover { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.06); filter: brightness(1.03); } .how-reel-playIcon { width: 0; height: 0; border-top: 16px solid transparent; border-bottom: 16px solid transparent; <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sys_user</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>assign role app user to the new users</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    // Add your code here
    if (current.user_name.nil()) return;

    var ROLE_NAME = 'x_1850691_zeyad_0.user';
    var roleGR = new GlideRecord('sys_user_role');
    roleGR.addQuery('name', ROLE_NAME);
    roleGR.query();
    if (!roleGR.next()) return;


    var has = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
    has.addQuery('user', current.sys_id);
    has.addQuery('role', roleGR.sys_id);
    has.query();
    if (has.hasNext()) return;

    var ur = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
    ur.initialize();
    ur.user = current.sys_id;
    ur.role = roleGR.sys_id;
    ur.insert();



})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-04 17:40:18</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d0f8c7a48312f6108372fecfeeaad3f8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>assign role app user to the new users</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="zeyad test " source="x_1850691_zeyad_0">6c84e75783b132108372fecfeeaad3bb</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="zeyad test ">6c84e75783b132108372fecfeeaad3bb</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d0f8c7a48312f6108372fecfeeaad3f8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-04 17:40:18</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d0f8c7a48312f6108372fecfeeaad3f8"/></record_update>
